characterList.description: Male, middle-aged, wearing a grey T-shirt with a 'Ruby Rose Sailing' logo. He has a goatee and short, dark hair tied in a bun.

content_metadata.description: A journey through the near-complete catamaran, showcasing its features and exceptional craftsmanship.

qAndA.answer: The Narrator points out the fixed escape hatches, emphasizing their importance in case of emergencies.
qAndA.question: What safety feature does the Narrator highlight underneath the boat?

qAndA.answer: The galley tap is a pull-out sprayer, similar to those found in modern home kitchens.
qAndA.question: What unique feature does the galley tap have?

qAndA.answer: The bench seat provides a footrest for the helmsperson and seating for two passengers, ensuring comfort and visibility.
qAndA.question: What does the bench seat opposite the helm offer?

qAndA.answer: The Narrator repeatedly expresses his admiration for the exceptional joinery and craftsmanship, highlighting the quality of the boat's construction.
qAndA.question: What aspect of the interior construction does the Narrator praise extensively?

qAndA.answer: He asks viewers to share pictures of their own boat joinery, encouraging a sense of community and comparison.
qAndA.question: What challenge does the Narrator issue to the viewers?

activities.description: Narrator speaks about the boat's progress

mood.description: Excited - Narrator's enthusiastic tone and the unveiling of the near-finished boat create a sense of anticipation.

He encourages viewers to continue following the progress.

activities.description: Narrator points to lightning protection system

mood.description: Curious - Exploring the often unseen underside of the catamaran adds a layer of intrigue.

narrativeProgression.description: The narrator shifts focus to the underside of the boat.
He highlights the fixed escape hatches and the lightning protection system.

mood.description: Excited - The anticipation builds as the Narrator prepares to step aboard and explore the interior for the first time.

narrativeProgression.description: The Narrator shares his first impressions as he boards the boat.
He points out important safety features, like the fire port.
The dinghy/tender is shown, marking another milestone in the boat's completion.

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition from the underside of the hull to boarding the boat.
Cut to an exterior view of the dinghy/tender.

activities.description: Narrator explains the purpose of the fire port
Narrator walks through the cockpit area
Narrator talks about the joinery of the boat
Narrator issues a challenge to viewers

characterInteraction.description: The Narrator interacts with the Vietnamese Worker, requesting him to move some cardboard.
The Narrator interacts with the Worker with Mask.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The Narrator's playful interaction with the Vietnamese worker and his "nap" on the sofa add a personal touch, making the video relatable.

mood.description: Happy - Narrator's positive reactions and commentary combined with the revealed details of the boat's luxurious interior contribute to a happy and enthusiastic atmosphere.

keyMoments.changeDescription: From excited to a more playful tone as the Narrator lies down on the sofa.

narrativeProgression.description: The Narrator continues exploring the interior, highlighting key areas like the galley and chart table.
He showcases the comfort and functionality of the seating.
Emphasis shifts to the exceptional joinery and craftsmanship of the interior.
The Narrator encourages viewers to share examples of their own boat joinery.

scenes.thematicElements: Attention to Detail: The video highlights the meticulous craftsmanship and features that contribute to a luxurious sailing experience. Practicality and Comfort: The design emphasizes both functionality and the comfort of the living spaces.
scenes.title: Interior Tour

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to a view of the interior from the doorway.
Cut to close-up shots of the tap and window.

mood.description: Excited - The video ends on a high note, leaving viewers excited about the upcoming completion of the catamaran.

narrativeProgression.description: The narrator concludes the episode, expressing excitement for the final stages of the build.

videoEditingDetails.description: Outro animation with water and logo

climax.description: The climax occurs when the Narrator begins to express his awe at the quality of the boat's joinery.

storylines.description: The journey of a near-complete catamaran, showcasing its features and emphasizing the exceptional craftsmanship.

youtube_description:
Today Nick gets to do something he's waited 4 years to do which makes him VERY happy (and slightly emotional). We take you through all the latest build updates inside and out as well as some features you've never seen on this boat before. Enjoy!

Thanks for watching! Please subscribe and leave a comment ⛵️ 

To support our work ❤️ https://www.patreon.com/sailingrubyrose

00:00 Intro
00:30 Under
01:05 Above
06:49 Below
09:00 Subscribe!

Our videos are free for everyone to watch, and always will be. However, we have an amazing community of Patrons who, for the cost of a cup of coffee a month, receive all sorts of benefits and perks. This support allows us to continue bringing our stories to you, so a HUGE thanks to our wonderful Patrons 😊 Click the link above to find out more. 

If Patreon isn't your thing, there's a lot of other ways to show your support (and it won't cost you a single penny): http://yachtrubyrose.com/say-thanks/ 


SOCIAL MEDIA 

We update our Instagram almost daily. This showcases images of us, the boat, and our surroundings. Our Instagram stories gives you a glimpse into 'behind the scenes' and reminds you when our new episodes are out- plus anything else we feel like documenting! The link is here:

http://www.instagram.com/sailingrubyrose

Want to see our blog? All the entries we have written, and all our travel before we started our Youtube channel? Well then this is where you need to look. You can also subscribe to our newsletter!

http://www.yachtrubyrose.com

Interested in our Facebook page? Again, we post almost daily with pictures, small videos and stories of our daily life. Check us out here:

http://www.facebook.com/sailingrubyrose

Want to read our Tweets? Images, videos and our thoughts, almost on a daily basis? Well look here for that:

http://www.twitter.com/yachtrubyrose

MUSIC

All tracks featured in this episode are credited at the end of the video in the order that they appear. We get all our music from Epidemic Sound and Artlist. 

⛵  - About Us: http://yachtrubyrose.com/our-story/
⛵  - Contact Us: http://yachtrubyrose.com/contact-us/

Hey there! We're Nick and Terysa and we’ve become completely obsessed with the idea of sailing around the world and sharing our experiences and information through our sailing lifestyle videos with others. 

We met travelling around India, and quickly agreed that rather than “settling down” and doing what most normal people do, we wanted to travel and adventure instead and started our sailing lifestyle adventure stories, since then, we’ve been working hard towards achieving our dreams, and now we’re finally living them as sailing cruising lifestyle! 

Want to know anything about our sailing lifestyle or sailing adventure stories? Send us an email via the contact us page http://yachtrubyrose.com/contact-us/
We hope you enjoy what we do. Please subscribe, like and share.

Thanks so much for watching! Please subscribe, leave a comment and give a thumbs up.
